findings.evidence: JointPhaseCommandExecutable.RunAsync creates a30s CTS at entry and passes it through command.ExecuteAsync. InstalledPhaseExecutor separately permits completionTimeoutSeconds up to86400. Startup/input bounds now cancel an otherwise accepted longer admitted partition; subsequent owner recovery is metadata-only and cannot execute missing cases.

QualificationOwnerOperationHandler validates QualificationBindings/QualificationCases before awaited source work. The final receiver result barrier compares enrollment/scope/trust and the caller grant only; neither dictionary nor the relevant enrollment policy is compared/revalidated. A surviving-head policy replacement with the same valid grant can therefore precede newly framed old-enrollment evidence.

Fr34OwnerOperationHandler has no RequiresCurrentResultAdmission override. Its actual persisted-reader and unseal paths await native/read operations, while the receiver only invokes the surviving current-result barrier for opted-in handlers. Revocation or changed FR34 target policy during that work is absent from the final result check.

fr34-unseal sets transferred=true and returns its owned plaintext byte[]; its finally deliberately clears only failed transfers. Receiver serialization and return have no corresponding success/failure ownership cleanup. fr34-replay returns PayloadUnprotectionOutcome, which can likewise own plaintext. No downstream reader can clear these distinct server arrays.

The signed response uses min(now+30,state.ValidUntil) but not grant.ValidUntil. The grant is checked at issuance only, so an authenticated response arriving after a short caller grant expiry can still pass the Dapr client response-time boundary for the remaining30s window.

coordinated_packets.admission requires candidate/status text in a command and validates an exact suffix plus equality with the accepted section. It never verifies that the prefix executes the two Git assertions. The isolated re-signed printf prefix retains those tokens/suffix and passes this guard, so the purported complete command need not perform its mandatory checkout checks.

Production AgentsHostComposition.TryCompose directly File.ReadAllText reads the selected profile/register/packet. No held descriptor, size limit or total startup deadline protects those reads; a FIFO or oversized selected file reaches the actual startup path before profile refusal. The pass10 bounded startup audit omitted this different AppHost caller.

QualificationInventoryRotationOriginalReader creates a denied nonmaterial state and changes only outcome/status. rotation/keyVersion/timing.rotatedAt stay null. Its actual returned source state is what the projector signs, while qualify.check_timing_and_attestations explicitly requires actual rotation fields for S1.rotation-invalidation. A successful source rotation cannot produce the required admissible observation even when the native facts are supplied.

AddInstalledAgentsOwningProcess rejects equal app IDs for spool/recorder and engine/observer, then directly constructs both accepted authorities. There is no comparison of public-key identity or credential binding for these pairs, so distinct IDs with one signing key and one mounted credential pass the claimed independence guard.

PublishCoreAsync first awaits worker admission and clones ReadOnlyMemory only inside its scheduled action. WaitAsync cancellation can complete the public task while that initial copy is still using caller-owned memory, which an async caller may then clear/reuse/return. The later token check prevents publication after cancellation but does not repair this input-lifetime violation; do not claim corrupted finals were demonstrated.

Spool reservation admission rejects null pending liability only, ignoring OriginalLiabilityVersion. Existing OriginalCompletionLiabilityTests explicitly represent a restored nonnull0/version0 undercount. Unlike private-original mutation, this spool path never initializes/migrates liabilities before using that0 to allocate archive space, so pending private completion headroom may be spent.

Pre-verified: cumulative16KiB header guard has no boundary test. Changing MAX_HEADERS to32KiB leaves the checked server test green, while a promptly sent17KiB loopback header changes from rejection/no dispatch to HTTP200/one dispatch. A within-limit positive and over-limit negative must exercise the actual receiver.
